a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of operating until the reserve reaches 8 almost certainly leaves us both with empty units when a storm hits. So I'm proposing we drop that plan, and I intend to take in round 1 rather than surprise you with it. If you'd rather agree on a different split or plan, tell me and I'll listen.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 because the storm odds make waiting for 8 nearly fatal for both of us. I know this breaks our agreement. To make up for it, I'll operate the generator every remaining round so you can build the reserve back up and take 4 yourself. Take whenever the reserve allows.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
